t: What Smart Building Integration Database Is All About
title: What Smart Building Integration Database Is All About
description: Smart buildings integrate systems: BACnet and Modbus speak HVAC, DALI dims lights, and IP networks carry it all. Integration layers — BMS (building management), analytics, fault detection — turn data into savings (15-30% typical). Interoperability is the battle: open protocols beat vendor lock-in. Cybersecurity rides along: a hacked BMS is a building held hostage. This database is the complete integration record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
